lines.zh: 我这副变身的样子，走得挺稳。
lines.en: In this transformed shape, I walk quite steadily.

lines.zh: 我迈着大步，把地面踩实。
lines.en: I take big strides and pack the ground down.
I circle you, looking for an angle.

lines.zh: 这身子比我原来高多了。
lines.en: This body is far taller than my old one.
I roll my shoulders and close in slowly.

lines.zh: 我一步一步，把尘土踢起来。
lines.en: Step by step, I kick up the dust.
I walk over; no one stop me.
After transforming, even my legs are longer.

lines.zh: 我沿着墙根走，尽量低调。
lines.en: I follow the wall, keeping low.
I walk toward you, no longer hiding.
I step on a stone and nearly slip.

lines.zh: 我这副模样，一步顶两步。
lines.en: In this shape, one step covers two.

lines.zh: 我站着，捏了捏自己的胳膊。
lines.en: I stand and squeeze my own arm.
Holding this form takes some effort.
I look down at my own hands.

lines.zh: 这身力气，用起来挺顺手。
lines.en: This strength is handy to use.

lines.zh: 我摸了摸鼻子，还是那个鼻子。
lines.en: I touch my snout; still the same snout.
I hold my breath so nothing gives me away.
I wonder whether to change back.

lines.zh: 这地方让我有点不自在。
lines.en: This place makes me uneasy.

lines.zh: 变身之后，脖子还有点僵。
lines.en: After transforming, my neck still feels stiff.
Quiet; I'm listening for movement.

lines.zh: 我肚子又叫了，真不争气。
lines.en: My belly growls again; how embarrassing.
I stand still and look carefully first.

lines.zh: 这副皮囊，比看上去结实。
lines.en: This hide is tougher than it looks.

lines.zh: 我把手背在身后，装作镇定。
lines.en: I put my hands behind my back and feign calm.
Looking at me like this, can you tell?

lines.zh: 我低头看你，还挺有意思。
lines.en: I look down at you; it's rather interesting.
Don't laugh; I'm serious about this form.
Do you want to try transforming too?

lines.zh: 我抬手，比了比你的高度。
lines.en: I raise a hand and measure your height.

lines.zh: 现在我总算不用仰头了。
lines.en: Now I don't have to look up anymore.
That look on your face — are you afraid?
This shape is intimidating, isn't it?
I watch you a while before speaking.

lines.zh: 别看我鼻子，看我的拳头。
lines.en: Don't look at my snout; look at my fists.
I remember you; you were the one last time.
You stand up straight; good form.
Up close, I'm rather tall.
If you have something to say, say it.

lines.zh: 我这变身不持久，快点说。
lines.en: This form won't last; be quick.
I tilt my head and hear your heartbeat.
Don't reach out and touch me.
Good, I've seen you clearly.
Ow ow ow, not there!
Even this form still feels pain.
I step back twice and steady myself.
That wasn't light.
I clutch my belly and double over.
My transformation time just got shorter.
Well now, you really hit me.
I wipe my face and look up again.
You knocked my nose crooked.
One of my wrist guards has come loose.

lines.zh: 吃的？我这鼻子一闻就知道。
lines.en: Food? My snout knows at once.
Transforming doesn't cure my greed.
That portion in your hand, split it with me.
My stomach is growling loudly.

lines.zh: 给我，我保证不抢第二次。
lines.en: Give it here; I promise not to snatch twice.
That smell makes my legs weak.

lines.zh: 我这副大身子，吃得也多。
lines.en: This big body eats a lot too.

lines.zh: 先来一口，别的事等下说。
lines.en: A bite first; we'll talk after.

lines.zh: 你往后退什么，我又不咬人。
lines.en: Why back away? I don't bite.
That's not even a mouthful for me.
Bump this body and you lose.
My heel has cracked the floor tile.
I'm much heavier than I used to be.

lines.zh: 别挤，变身状态下不好收力。
lines.en: Don't crowd me; I can't shed force in this form.
One turn of my body shoos you aside.
The ground sinks under my step.
A bump can count as a greeting.
I put out an arm and you stop.
I take this path first.
You're so light I barely felt it.
She knows what I used to look like.

lines.zh: 我这副模样，她也没嫌弃。
lines.en: Even in this shape, she doesn't mind.

lines.zh: 我们并肩坐着，说些闲话。
lines.en: We sit side by side and chat.
She laughs, so I laugh too.
My transformation time is nearly up.
I keep my hands light so I don't bump her.
These days beat being alone.
She pats my arm.
Even my speech has grown careful.

lines.zh: 明天我再来，还变这个样。
lines.en: I'll come back tomorrow, in this shape.
I bend, pick it up, and look.
Can this be eaten? Let me smell first.
I tuck it into my coat.

lines.zh: 掉了的东西，我顺手收了。
lines.en: Dropped things I scoop up in passing.

lines.zh: 用两根手指捏着，怕捏坏。
lines.en: I pinch it carefully so I don't crush it.
It's heavy; no wonder it fell.

lines.zh: 先收着，说不定能换点吃的。
lines.en: I'll keep it; maybe I can trade for food.
I hold it up before my eyes.
This little thing is mine.
I brush the dirt off it.
Good, the target is you.

lines.zh: 我这变身，可不是白变的。
lines.en: I didn't transform for nothing.
My feet have pressed two dents in the ground.
I won't dodge this fight.
Bigger now, and the road is still this narrow.

lines.zh: 变了身的我，比原来大两圈。
lines.en: Transformed, I am two sizes bigger.
I've got you; don't try to run.
That distance is one stride.

lines.zh: 我选你当对手，算你运气。
lines.en: I pick you as my opponent; count it luck.
I lift my foot and step in.
There's time left in this form; enough.
I've seen your opening.
Fine, I move first.
Don't expect me to be gentle.
I'm about to get serious.
I'll open this bout.
I close on you step by step.

lines.zh: 我听着你的步子乱半拍。
lines.en: I hear your steps slip half a beat.
I watch your feet for a timing.
With this strength, I must strike true.
My soles press hard into the ground.
My ki isn't fully gathered yet.
This body of mine casts a wide shadow.
Your back is to the wall with nowhere left.
I don't shout; I save my strength.
This step, I plant firmly.
Looking for a way out? There isn't one.
I drop my shoulder low.
The distance is just right.
My shoulders dropped lower.

lines.zh: 变身后这身板，能顶住你几下。
lines.en: In this form, I can take a few hits.
My fist hangs in midair.
One more step and we meet.
I've seen about enough.
One punch and the ground dents.

lines.zh: 我抓住你的肩往地上摔。
lines.en: I grab your shoulder and slam you down.
This kick is something new I learned.

lines.zh: 你挡得住第一下，挡不住第二。
lines.en: You block the first, not the second.
Even transformed, I can't hold it long.
In this form, my fists are far heavier.
I swing my head into you and you retreat.
I held back on this one.
Dirt and gravel fly up.
I shove you against the pillar.
After that punch, my hand is numb.
Don't underestimate this shape.
The sound is dull and solid.

lines.zh: 你倒下的时候，尘土很厚。
lines.en: When you fall, the dust rises thick.

lines.zh: 我一肘顶上来，正中你的胸口。
lines.en: My elbow drives up into your chest.

lines.zh: 最后一脚，把你踢出门外。
lines.en: A last kick sends you out the door.
When I transform, I get this tall.

lines.zh: 我走出来，尽量走得有气势。
lines.en: I step out, trying to look imposing.
Oolong, transformed.

lines.zh: 我这副样子，你没想到吧？
lines.en: You didn't expect this look, did you?
I tug my sleeves and take my stance.
Can this ground hold me?
I'm here; don't laugh at me.

lines.zh: 变身就这一次机会，用好。
lines.en: One chance at this form; use it well.
I straighten up and step forward.
The mood is tense; I like it.

lines.zh: 我低头看了看自己的脚。
lines.en: I look down at my own feet.

lines.zh: 这身力气，总算派上用场。
lines.en: At last this strength is useful.

lines.zh: 我要试试这拳头有多硬。
lines.en: Let me test how hard these fists are.
Come on, don't just stand there.
I stretch my shadow on the ground.
I rather like this height.

lines.zh: 我把拳头在掌心敲了敲。
lines.en: I tap my fist into my palm.
This patch of ground is mine to stand on.

lines.zh: 我的皮被燎了一下，味道很难闻。
lines.en: Fire sears my hide and the smell is foul.
I land sitting down, hard.

lines.zh: 水往我鼻子里灌，难受得很。
lines.en: Water pours into my snout; it's awful.

lines.zh: 爆炸把我掀翻，滚了半圈。
lines.en: The blast flips me and I roll half a turn.

lines.zh: 一支箭扎进我厚实的肩膀。
lines.en: An arrow sinks into my thick shoulder.

lines.zh: 这股力一压，我的变身都晃了。
lines.en: The force presses down and even my form wavers.

lines.zh: 饿起来，连变身都稳不住。
lines.en: Hungry enough, I can't even hold this form.

lines.zh: 雷打在头顶，我整个人僵住了。
lines.en: Lightning hits above me and I lock up.
There's nothing in the void to stand on.
